Internal and external parasite care

Valmectin Super

A veterinary injectable for internal and external parasite care.

Valmectin Super is a veterinary solution for injection. The supplied packaging describes treatment and control of mixed internal and external parasitic infections, and shows a 100 ml vial for animal treatment only. A veterinarian should confirm suitability and use from the official product information.

Where this product fits.

The photographed packaging describes treatment and control of mixed internal and external parasitic infections. Similar product names can represent different formulations. Confirm the complete composition, species, route and locally authorised instructions before use.

Diagnosis, the animal’s condition and the exact product instructions should guide selection. A general care category is a starting point for a professional conversation, rather than a prescription for every animal in that category.

Administration & dosage.

The numerical dose must come from the current locally authorised leaflet and the prescribing veterinarian. A dose from another brand, a similar name or a different concentration cannot be substituted safely.

Have these details ready

  • Exact product name, active ingredients and concentration.
  • Species, current body weight, age and relevant health history.
  • Prescribed amount, administration route, frequency and duration.
  • Any applicable preparation, handling and withdrawal instructions.

Injection technique, route and administration precautions are product-specific and require appropriate professional instruction. Clarify any uncertainty before administration.

Read the medicine-use guide

Keep the instructions traceable.

Retain the product leaflet and record batch details, expiry, treatment dates and the veterinarian’s instructions. For food-producing animals, record the applicable withdrawal interval and completion date. Follow the exact storage and any in-use period specified for this presentation.

USEFUL QUESTIONS

Before you take the next step.

Can I use a dose from a similar product?+

No. Concentration, formulation, route and authorisation can differ. Obtain the current leaflet for this exact product and follow the veterinarian’s prescription.

Where can I confirm availability and documentation?+

Use the product enquiry page to prepare a request for the approved leaflet, technical documentation and availability in your market.

Is an approval or launch date listed here?+

The supplied pack does not establish an authenticated approval or launch date. Request dated manufacturer documentation for regulatory or procurement decisions.
